model_display_name: Cisco ASR 9000 Series Aggregation Services Router
description: 운영 환경 기준 Cisco ASR 9000 (IOS XR 26.1.x) 코어/애그리게이션 라우터의 표준 운영 컨피그레이션. 시스템 관리, AAA, 관리/물리 인터페이스, IS-IS/OSPF/BGP 라우팅, MPLS LDP, QoS 정책, 보안 ACL, SNMP를 포함한 단일 전체 설정.
full_config:
!
! Cisco ASR 9000 Series — Standard Operational Baseline
! IOS XR Release 26.1.x
! Role: Core / Aggregation Router
!
!======================================================================
! 1. System
!======================================================================
hostname ASR9000-Core-Router
domain name example.com
!
clock timezone UTC 0
ntp
 server 10.1.1.1
 server 10.1.1.2 prefer
 source MgmtEth0/RSP0/CPU0/0
!
banner login ^C
*****************************************************************
*  Authorized access only. Disconnect IMMEDIATELY if you are    *
*  not an authorized user. All activity is monitored and logged.*
*****************************************************************
^C
!
logging buffered 4096 debug
logging console critical
logging trap informational
logging 10.1.1.10 vrf default severity info
logging source-interface Loopback0
service timestamps log datetime msec
service timestamps debug datetime msec
!
!======================================================================
! 2. AAA / TACACS+ / RADIUS / SSH
!======================================================================
tacacs-server host 10.1.1.20 port 49
 key 0 MyTACACSKey123
!
radius-server host 10.1.1.21 auth-port 1812 acct-port 1813
radius-server key 0 MyRadiusKey456
!
aaa authentication login default group tacacs+ local
aaa authentication enable default group tacacs+ enable
aaa authorization exec default group tacacs+ local
aaa accounting exec default start-stop group tacacs+
aaa accounting commands default start-stop group tacacs+
!
ssh server v2
ssh server vrf default
ssh server vrf mgmt
ssh timeout 30
ssh server rate-limit 60
ssh server session-limit 16
ssh key-exchange group dh-group14-sha1
!
line default
 exec-timeout 10 0
 session-timeout 15
 transport input ssh
!
line console
 exec-timeout 10 0
!
vty-pool default 0 16
!
!======================================================================
! 3. Management Interface (Out-of-Band) + VRF
!======================================================================
vrf mgmt
 address-family ipv4 unicast
 address-family ipv6 unicast
!
interface MgmtEth0/RSP0/CPU0/0
 description ** OOB Management — Primary **
 vrf mgmt
 ipv4 address 192.168.1.100 255.255.255.0
 ipv6 address 2001:db8::100/64
 no shutdown
!
interface MgmtEth0/RSP0/CPU0/1
 description ** OOB Management — Secondary **
 vrf mgmt
 ipv4 address 192.168.1.101 255.255.255.0
 no shutdown
!
router static
 address-family ipv4 unicast
  0.0.0.0/0 10.0.1.254
 !
 vrf mgmt
  address-family ipv4 unicast
   0.0.0.0/0 192.168.1.1
  !
 !
!
!======================================================================
! 4. Loopback (Router-ID / IGP / BGP source)
!======================================================================
interface Loopback0
 description ** Router-ID / IGP / iBGP Source **
 ipv4 address 10.10.10.1 255.255.255.255
 ipv6 address 2001:db8:ffff::1/128
!
!======================================================================
! 5. Physical Core / Access Interfaces
!======================================================================
interface TenGigE0/0/0/0
 description ** UPLINK -> Core-1 **
 mtu 9216
 ipv4 address 10.0.1.1 255.255.255.252
 ipv6 address 2001:db8:1::1/127
 load-interval 30
 flow-control ingress
 no shutdown
!
interface HundredGigE0/1/0/0
 description ** UPLINK -> Core-2 (100GE) **
 mtu 9216
 ipv4 address 10.0.2.1 255.255.255.252
 ipv6 address 2001:db8:2::1/127
 load-interval 30
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/2/0/0
 description ** Access -> Aggregation-Switch-A **
 mtu 1514
 ipv4 address 172.16.1.1 255.255.255.0
 negotiation auto
 no shutdown
!
!======================================================================
! 6. IS-IS (IGP) + Segment Routing MPLS
!======================================================================
router isis CoreISIS
 net 49.0001.0000.0000.0001.00
 is-type level-2-only
 nsf ietf
 log adjacency changes
 address-family ipv4 unicast
  metric-style wide
  segment-routing mpls
 !
 address-family ipv6 unicast
  metric-style wide
 !
 interface Loopback0
  passive
  address-family ipv4 unicast
   prefix-sid index 1
  !
  address-family ipv6 unicast
  !
 !
 interface TenGigE0/0/0/0
  point-to-point
  address-family ipv4 unicast
   metric 10
  !
  address-family ipv6 unicast
   metric 10
  !
 !
 interface HundredGigE0/1/0/0
  point-to-point
  address-family ipv4 unicast
   metric 5
  !
  address-family ipv6 unicast
   metric 5
  !
 !
!
!======================================================================
! 7. OSPF (Optional secondary IGP for legacy aggregation)
!======================================================================
router ospf 1
 router-id 10.10.10.1
 log adjacency changes detail
 auto-cost reference-bandwidth 100000
 timers throttle spf 50 200 5000
 nsf cisco
 area 0
  interface Loopback0
   passive enable
  !
  interface GigabitEthernet0/2/0/0
   cost 10
   hello-interval 10
   dead-interval 40
  !
 !
!
!======================================================================
! 8. BGP
!======================================================================
router bgp 65000
 bgp router-id 10.10.10.1
 bgp graceful-restart restart-time 300
 bgp graceful-shutdown
 !
 address-family ipv4 unicast
  redistribute connected
  redistribute static
  maximum-paths ebgp 4 eibgp 4
 !
 address-family ipv6 unicast
  redistribute connected
  maximum-paths ebgp 4
 !
 neighbor-group CORE-PEERS
  remote-as 65001
  update-source Loopback0
  timers 10 30
  timers connect-retry 30
  description ** eBGP Core Peers **
  address-family ipv4 unicast
   send-community-ebgp
  !
  address-family ipv6 unicast
   send-community-ebgp
  !
 !
 neighbor 10.0.1.2
  use neighbor-group CORE-PEERS
  description Core-1-BGP
 !
 neighbor 10.0.2.2
  use neighbor-group CORE-PEERS
  description Core-2-BGP
 !
!
!======================================================================
! 9. MPLS LDP
!======================================================================
mpls ldp
 router-id 10.10.10.1
 graceful-restart
 address-family ipv4
 !
 interface TenGigE0/0/0/0
 !
 interface HundredGigE0/1/0/0
 !
!
!======================================================================
! 10. QoS Policy (Ingress/Egress 3-class baseline)
!======================================================================
class-map match-any CRITICAL-TRAFFIC
 match dscp ef
 match protocol bgp
 end-class-map
!
class-map match-any VIDEO-TRAFFIC
 match dscp af41 af42
 match protocol http https
 end-class-map
!
class-map match-any DEFAULT-TRAFFIC
 match any
 end-class-map
!
policy-map QOS-INGRESS
 class CRITICAL-TRAFFIC
  priority level 1
  police rate 100 mbps burst 10 ms
 !
 class VIDEO-TRAFFIC
  priority level 2
  police rate 500 mbps burst 50 ms
 !
 class DEFAULT-TRAFFIC
  queue-limit 100 ms
  random-detect dscp-based
 !
 end-policy-map
!
interface TenGigE0/0/0/0
 service-policy input QOS-INGRESS
 service-policy output QOS-INGRESS
!
interface HundredGigE0/1/0/0
 service-policy input QOS-INGRESS
 service-policy output QOS-INGRESS
!
!======================================================================
! 11. Security ACL (Management plane lockdown)
!======================================================================
ipv4 access-list MGMT-ACL
 10 permit tcp 10.1.0.0/16 any eq 22
 20 permit tcp 192.168.1.0/24 any eq 22
 30 deny tcp any any eq 22 log
 40 permit ipv4 any any
!
interface MgmtEth0/RSP0/CPU0/0
 ipv4 access-group MGMT-ACL ingress
!
!======================================================================
! 12. SNMP
!======================================================================
snmp-server community ReadOnlyCommunity RO
snmp-server host 10.1.1.30 traps version 2c ReadOnlyCommunity
snmp-server traps bgp
snmp-server traps isis
snmp-server traps ospf state-change
snmp-server traps mpls ldp
snmp-server contact noc@example.com
snmp-server location DC1-Rack-A12
!
end
